amendment_reason: Preoutcome pinned-source audit found that grid_pipeline can return success after a nonfatal weld-audit warning, pinch_verts was omitted, and candidate-only same_dir_pairs == 0 was asymmetric despite same-direction pairs being cosmetic in grid_weld. The v2 lock therefore reads weld_report.json directly, adds pinch validity, makes same-direction pairs baseline-relative with zero retained as a secondary clean-mesh result, and adds an internal-seam unpaired-edge comparison.
amendment_blindness_evidence: At 2026-08-12T00:40:24Z the seed-39 odd-fold training process and all three watchers were alive; no pilot verdict, final result, or release manifest existed or was inspected.
question: Does the registered physical-label fine-tuning treatment improve an untouched PHerc0139 surface-probability grid without worsening topology, and does the improvement survive ScrollFiesta meshing and seam welding?

region.selection: 2x2x2 grid anchored at the already hash-selected z-stratum-0 visual case PHerc0139-z0192-y1280-x0192; no model prediction or outcome was used

inference.candidate_permission: only after a POSITIVE_DEPLOYABLE registered final result
inference.candidate: equal-weight mean of all twelve PHerc0139 predictions: seeds 40-45 times folds even and odd
inference.normalization: exact plans.json CT normalization fixed by Villa PR 1386
inference.context_policy: infer the 384^3 context and retain only the central 256^3 locked world box

requirements: resumable only when every existing chunk matches its receipt
wall time, peak RAM, peak VRAM, and bytes written

matched_mass.candidate: select exactly N voxels over the full locked 256^3 box, where N is the baseline fixed-threshold foreground count; stable descending probability then C-order index

topology_metric.note: 63 repeated level-1 voxels become 504 level-0 voxels, matching ScrollFiesta's 500-voxel component floor; the old binary_fill_holes metric is forbidden
reported: truth components split across multiple prediction components
prediction components merging multiple truth components
recto precision, recall, Dice, and foreground mass

weld_metric.source: parse the final welded OBJ independently; do not infer topology validity from grid_pipeline exit status
weld_metric.internal_seam_unpaired_edge_definition: An undirected final-OBJ edge with exactly one incident face whose midpoint is within 1.0 level-0 voxel of an internal cube plane and more than 1.0 level-0 voxel from every outer face of the locked world box. Report the union count and one count per internal plane; an edge at an internal-plane intersection is counted once in the union and once for each matching plane.
weld_metric.baseline_semantics: The baseline is a comparator and need not pass candidate validity. A baseline defect may be repaired by the candidate, but neither candidate arm may contain a non-manifold edge or pinch vertex.

matched_mass_input_gate: candidate aggregate total component errors <= baseline
candidate improves per-cube symmetric surface-distance median on at least 5 of 8 cubes
fixed_threshold_safety_gate: candidate aggregate total component errors <= baseline
no cube regresses by more than 0.5 level-1 voxel in symmetric surface-distance median
scrollfiesta_gate: all three direct grid_pipeline commands exit zero: baseline fixed, candidate fixed, candidate matched-mass; exit zero is not accepted as a substitute for parsing the weld report and final OBJ
candidate processes every cube processed by baseline and introduces no garbage rejection or crash
weld report exists with exactly 8 cubes and correct multi-cube world span
candidate non_manifold == 0 and pinch_verts == 0 in both candidate arms
candidate same_dir_pairs <= baseline same_dir_pairs in each candidate arm; candidate same_dir_pairs == 0 is reported separately as the stricter clean-mesh result
candidate internal-seam unpaired-edge union count and every per-plane count <= baseline in each candidate arm
all stage logs, final per-cube meshes, welded OBJ, and weld report are hash-bound
visual_evidence: fixed orthogonal center cross-sections through world coordinate [3968,3840,1472]
identical CT window and colors for baseline, candidate, and physical truth
fixed welded-mesh camera and uncropped failure panels

claim_boundary.pass: supports a bounded untouched-PHerc0139 probability-to-ScrollFiesta meshing/weld improvement claim
does_not_prove: automatic repair of every hole, merger, or sheet switch
default deployment safety outside the locked region
claim_boundary.failure: publish the bounded negative result and make no downstream-improvement claim
